Crude Oil Prices Surge Amid US-Iran Tensions, Fuel Costs Eyed

International crude oil prices have neared $100 per barrel due to escalating tensions between the United States and Iran. This surge in global oil prices has led to speculation about potential increases in petrol and diesel prices in India. Companies have released their latest rates for petrol and diesel amidst this volatile market.
